PHX - FLIGHT DEPARTED PHX EN ROUTE TO IAH WITH THE LEFT PACK ON MEL. DURING CRUISE, CREW REPORTED THE CABIN WAS VERY HOT AND WOULD NOT COOL DOWN. CREW ALSO REPORTED THAT SOME OILY FUMES WERE PRESENT IN THE FLIGHT DECK. ODOR WAS SIMILAR TO THAT OF WHEN A HEATER TURNS ON. PASSENGERS BEGAN TO COMPLAIN THAT HOT AIR WAS STILL COMING OUT OF THE AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM. THE RIGHT PACK WAS IN HIGH FLOW AND CABIN TEMPERATURE GAUGE WAS 80 DEGREES F. CREW USED STANDBY PRESSURIZATION MODE TO TAKE CABIN TO 6,000 FEET, AND AFTER TURNBACK AND 40 MINUTES OF FLIGHT, SOME RELIEF WAS ACHIEVED IN CABIN.
